mapping_basis: Reference 001–010 maps sequentially to caption 1–10 and canonical stanza 1–10, verified against the Stotra Nidhi chapter sequence; images 011–012 are numbered Tamil text stencils, not scene references.

images.observed_reference: Nanda travels to Mathura and meets Vasudeva.
images.caption_text_exact: King Nandagopan went to the kingdom of Mathura to pay taxes where Kamsa is ruling,. Vasudeva met Nadagopan and talked affectionately and very friendly to him.

images.observed_reference: Vasudeva congratulates Nanda on Krishna’s birth.
images.caption_text_exact: Vasudeva congratulated Nandagopan and expressed his happiness over him on the birth of a son and conveyed that he is as happy as he would have got one.

images.observed_reference: Vasudeva warns Nanda to return quickly because of bad omens.
images.caption_text_exact: Vasudeva warned Nandagopan of the bad omens which are felt at Gokulam at that time and hence instructed him to return home back as quickly as possible. Hearing it, Nandagopan was apprehended and took his way to Gokulam.

images.observed_reference: Putana arrives at Nanda’s household in disguise.
images.caption_text_exact: In the meanwhile, Putana, the demoness, under Kamsa's order visited Nandagopan's house in the disguise of a beautiful woman, with hair adorned with beautiful and attractive flowers.

images.observed_reference: Putana takes Krishna while the gopis watch.
images.caption_text_exact: Putana, who killed several infants, lifted Krishna in her hand. The other Gopikas wondered amongst themselves as to who this beautiful lady was.

images.observed_reference: Putana begins nursing Krishna in the house.
images.caption_text_exact: Awestruck by her charming looks, Gopikas did not obstruct her when she took the child in her hand. She chose a place in the house and started to feed the child with her breast milk.

images.observed_reference: Putana’s alarmed face with Krishna at her breast conveys the fatal nursing episode; the intimate framing does not show the full act, but caption and sequence establish it.
images.caption_text_exact: Angered at Putana's killing of innocent children, Krishna fearlessly climbed on to her body and sucked the poison smeared breasts as if it was a huge mango fruit.

images.observed_reference: Putana’s body falls in giant demoness form as villagers approach.
images.caption_text_exact: Krishna sucked the life of Putana, acting as if he was sucking the milk. She fell on the ground making thunderous sound with both hands stretched, reverting to her huge demoness form.

images.observed_reference: Gokula villagers gather at the fallen body while Krishna is recovered.
images.caption_text_exact: Hearing the huge sound, entire Gokulam was in a state of shock. Seeing Krishna playing innocently on the dead body of Putana, Gopikas came and picked him up hurriedly.

images.observed_reference: Gopis surround and ritually bathe/protect the child, consistent with their protective naming/prayer.
images.caption_text_exact: Gopikas prayed to Bhagwan, chanting his various names which brings auspiciousness to the world, seeking him to protect the child without knowing that Bhagwan only is in the form of child Krishna in their hands.
